title: 5 suspected members of robbery group killed in Bacoor shootout

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Five suspected members of an alleged organized robbery group were killed in a shootout with police following a chase near the Molino 4 flyover in Bacoor City, Cavite on Tuesday afternoon, Nov. 3, authorities said. According to initial reports, the suspects were planning to rob an exclusive subdivision along Molino Boulevard when police spotted them. A chase ensued as the suspects and police officers aboard separate vehicles exchanged gunfire, resulting in the deaths of all five suspects.
